note: Hand-audited classification of every lexicon occurrence of the base tree, one occurrence at a time. The first rule whose conditions all hold decides the occurrence fields: path (ECMAScript regular expression on the masked path, derive/scan.mjs#maskPath), kind (path: line 0 only; content: lines 1 and above), lines, families, entries (the occurrence entry), keys (the SHA-256 of the occurrence normalised key) and forms. An occurrence matched by no rule is unmatched and fails the ledger build. A rule category of "family" takes the category of the occurrence family from familyCategory. Rules are evaluated in array order; their ids are stable labels (R-184, added by the first seal consistency review, sits before R-109). No rule names a scanned literal: version 1 line patterns became key or entry conditions.

disposition.inject: The hard-coded value at this site is replaced by a read of the injected data named by target (new path) or legacyAdapter (business-policy/1 path); the literal or identifier carrying the value does not remain at this site.
disposition.remove: The policy is deleted without a library replacement; the DESIGN target behaviour applies instead.
disposition.replace: The consumer is re-implemented as a profile-driven lot 3-5 consumer; any surviving legacy module keeps only generic code whose business reads are inject rows.
disposition.legacy-api: Public legacy API name, literal or internal legacy-model identifier retained as an opaque key; it selects nothing by itself and every value it names is resolved through injected data.
disposition.test-input: Test code or fixture data kept as legacy-adapter test input; the test supplies business-policy/1 or a profile explicitly and its expected values are unchanged.
disposition.neutral-successor: Public test or fixture embedding business look values; replaced by a synthetic neutral successor, the exact business expectation moving to the private integration corpus (DESIGN.md:889).
disposition.doc-update: Documentation or source comment rewritten to describe injected data; it describes no built-in business default.
disposition.history-record: Immutable historical record, not shipped; retained.
disposition.context-generic: Reviewed context match with a generic meaning; retained.
disposition.retain-notice: Required third-party notice or third-party data; retained.

modules.note: Role classifiers keep their generic prefix and stripping algorithms and take every marker, trim and case from business-policy/1; with no policy they recognise nothing and strip nothing (probe 1).

Legacy layout input reads role markers from business-policy/1; the implicit retarget of links to an earlier activity is removed (preserve endpoints and report); legacy layout-model kinds are opaque identifiers whose kind tags are injected.

Band dimensions, corridor width, badge contribution, document geometry, node sizes, fonts and line height come from business-policy/1. Generic spacing constants (LEFT_PAD, COL_GAP, ROW_GAP, RIGHT_PAD, GROUP_GAP, CENTRE_GAP, CELL_W) and inline fit paddings and width bounds are retained as generic geometry primitives.

Generic measurement and greedy wrapping retained; advance tables, fallback width, width aliases and line height are injected (resources[kind=metrics] or business-policy/1 #/metrics); no ambient normalization.
Editor auto-layout command classifies application annotations and spaces their badges from injected data.
Built-in look registry, default look, per-look palette clearance, marker selectors and palette icon colours are replaced by injected looks; with no look the canvas draws upstream notation.
Legacy public names stay as opaque keys; the browser entry stops exporting the built-in default token tables and palette action ids.
No descriptor is forced into the codecs; the private descriptor document, its checksum export and the package export leave the generic distribution; callers inject descriptor packages.

Legacy reference exporters read role markers, application host eligibility, export styles and optional facts from business-policy/1; byte-identical old output is reproduced only from the private integration legacy data pinned in legacy-values.json.
Reference-look symbol decoding and the role marker inserted in decoded labels come from business-policy/1 #/presentation/exportStyles/decode and the role prefixes.

Annotated look: tokens, geometry, palette entries and role classification are injected. Its glyph drawers (process and component icons, wavy document outline with header band, badge rows) are look geometry without a lexical anchor; in the profile path they become themes[].glyphs under the OPEN-RENDER-PRIMITIVES default (unsupported composites disabled with appearance losses); exact legacy visuals remain on the pinned release (owner decision 5, DESIGN.md:1148).
Recolouring look and its flat shape drawers: classification and token defaults injected; flat drawers handled as M-11 glyph drawers.
Palette stylesheets keyed by look-prefixed action ids and the look root class; palette icons come from injected palette entries.
The implicit name navigation default is removed (calledElement only); explicit legacy rules stay an opt-in; formats select injected looks; native props and Result/1 methods are the lot 5 surface.
No lexicon hit. The XML-only preview through the default look becomes the tagged native preview artifact; the XML overload stays on the compatibility path with an explicitly injected look.
